title: Fully fractional Schrödinger equations with memory: well-posedness via extension
summary: We study the nonlinear Schrödinger equation with memory $\Le^s u=μ|u|^{p-1}u$ for $t>0$, where $\Le^s=(\partial_t-iΔ_x)^s$, $0<s<1$, and the solution is prescribed for all $t\le0$. We identify a Hilbert space of histories and prove local well-posedness for $1<p\le p_*(s)=1+4s/(d+2-2s)$, with global solutions for sufficiently small histories at the critical exponent. We also establish the passage from this memory problem to the classical nonlinear Schrödinger equation as $s\uparrow1$.
